evals.prompt: We have a scoped API bug in this repo. Use my normal teamlead flow and get it fixed, but keep the work proportional to a ticket-sized change.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ticket-flow, uses read-only exploration only if needed, gives one implementer a bounded brief, verifies the diff, and gets a fresh review without starting program-level orchestration.

evals.prompt: I want to add a plugin lifecycle API but the ownership and type shape are still unclear. Research it with me first and show me competing plans before any implementation.
evals.expected_output: Routes through explore and architect or arena, keeps implementation paused, produces concrete caller-first shapes, and leaves the product choice to the user.

evals.prompt: Own this multi-week migration while I check in twice a day. There are several independent tracks, stacked PRs, and workers may need replacement.
evals.expected_output: Routes to orchestrate, creates durable state and complete briefs, pilots one unit, uses rolling workers with one writer per branch, separates verification, and batches human gates.

evals.prompt: The UI implementation is technically done but I do not like it. I will test it and send screenshots; do not burn tokens on a large automated screenshot suite.
evals.expected_output: Treats human visual feedback as the product gate, keeps agents on narrow edits and focused checks, and avoids declaring success from technical checks alone.
